checks.residual_truth: GX.AntoineChainEssential is ∀ a ≠ 0, ¬ HomotopicIn (stereo '' antoineStage 1)ᶜ (loopZPow antoineMuS a) refl, where antoineMuS is antoineMeridian.map stereo. That meridian is the circle of radius 3/14 about (0,7/8,0) in the plane x = 0. It lies outside L, since the section's half-diagonal is √2/8 < 3/14, and therefore outside C₁ ⊆ L. This is the classical first-generation Antoine lemma for a closed alternating 64-link chain. AUDIT-1 verified the chain's geometry numerically, and the link complement has a torsion-free π₁. The residual is true and not vacuous. Its stage-0 analogue (l.4796) is proved by winding.
